description: iNAYATechLab Manpower SaaS - IVCS: International, Auditable, Phase-Mapped Versioning

rules.minor: Phase completion - each phase (20 steps) increments MINOR (1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 -> ... -> 3.0.0)
rules.patch: Hotfix / single step fix within phase (1.0.0 -> 1.0.1)
rules.tag: v prefix mandatory (v1.3.0), annotated tag with message

history.changes: Foundation: Next.js 14, TypeScript Strict, AES-256, Design System, Gift Automation, IVCS, Vercel, Deploy Alternatives

Super Admin & Company Backbone: CEO Non-Deletable, Firewall, Unrestricted, Audit Log, Dashboard, Global Config, 2FA, Master Key, Recovery, Impersonation, Health, CPU/Memory, System Log, Broadcast, Feature Flags, License, Backup

Multi-Tenant DB Schema: 30 tables + Prisma RLS (agencies, agency_settings, roles, permissions, users, user_profiles, departments, designations, skills, skill_categories, workers, worker_contacts, worker_documents, worker_skills, clients, client_contacts, job_sites, contracts, job_demands, worker_deployments, shift_schedules, timesheets, timesheet_entries, overtimes, payrolls, payroll_details, invoices, invoice_items, audit_logs, system_notifications)

Security, RLS & Data Isolation: RLS activate, 12 RLS policies (agencies, users, CEO bypass, workers, clients, contracts, job_sites, timesheets, payrolls, invoices, compliance), FK indexes, unique indexes, passport duplicate check, PK cascade, migration script, Supabase migrate, seed data (test agency + 5 workers), performance test, slow-query indexes, storage buckets (private/public/temp), security policies, encryption upload, image compression, watermark, signed URL, backup automation tune

Auth & 2FA: JWT session, signin/signup, Bcrypt, token rotation, RBAC, 5 guards, reset password, 2FA QR/TOTP, SMS OTP, lockout, session timeout, device block, IP block, brute-force, login tracking, secure cookies, CSRF, CORS, rate limiter, verification, OAuth, guest block, audit logger

Main Dashboard & Navigation UI: Global sidebar, dynamic nav, mobile drawer, header dropdown, notification bell, super admin overview, agency health card, 5 dashboards (agency, client, supervisor, worker), 6 metric cards, search, breadcrumb, skeleton
